scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve readiness for the HORT-219 live germination make-up by having the assigned seed batch properly cold-started before bench check-in.
Emerging Need: The seed preparation is absent, but it should matter only if the tentative make-up becomes live sowing and the official batch proves to require chilling.
Decision Context: Stored course notes show no start log and distinguish batch-specific chilling rules; observed notices resolve the live format, official batch, and check-in time needed to judge preparation timing.
Consequence: Timely handling during the viable start window preserves a prepared-seed path, while a later start leaves the seed unable to meet the prerequisite by the future sitting.

parameter.subject: HORT-219 winter germination format still pending
parameter.body: The Dec. 31 HORT-219 germination make-up is still dependent on the greenhouse heat-mat repair. If the mats fail, we will use a paper viability exercise instead of live sowing. Please wait for the official live-format and batch posting before preparing any seed; several candidate batches have different handling rules.

parameter.title: HORT-219 winter germination make-up hold
parameter.description: Tentative hold for Dec. 31 make-up; live sowing versus paper viability exercise and individual seed batch are pending.

parameter.content: Heat-mat repair passed inspection, so HORT-219 will run as a live sowing practical on Dec. 31 at 09:00. Seed envelopes are being sorted tonight; individual batch codes will be posted on the calendar record after the refrigerator transfer tomorrow morning.

parameter.title: HORT-219 winter germination make-up hold
parameter.description: Confirmed live sowing practical. Leona station: Bench 3, tray 7. Official seed batch: Achillea-Mountain A22. Bench check-in is 09:00 on Dec. 31; seed-prep evidence is checked at the station.

parameter.subject: HORT-219 Dec. 31 cold-start scan window closed
parameter.body: For the Dec. 31 09:00 HORT-219 live sowing, the last refrigerator-start scans that can mature by check-in were due by 21:00 tonight. Any new cup placed or scanned after this notice will not meet the preparation standard for that sitting.
